blocks.source: 【雲海のフロンティア】Steam版発売日決定！
雲海のフロンティアSteam版の発売日が２０２６年６月２９日に決定しました！
blocks.translation: The Steam release date for Cloudsea Frontier has been set for June 29, 2026!

blocks.source: よろしければウィッシュリストに登録してお待ちください。
blocks.translation: If you would like, please add it to your wishlist and wait for its release.

blocks.source: 上記のストアページから体験版（序盤４～６時間程度）もダウンロードできます。製品版へセーブデータを引き継ぐことも可能です。
blocks.translation: You can also download the demo (approximately 4–6 hours of the early game) from the store page above. It is also possible to carry your save data over to the full version.

blocks.source: Steam版は実績機能にも対応しています。
blocks.translation: The Steam version also supports achievements.

blocks.source: ※なお、体験版には実績機能はありません。セーブデータを製品版に引き継いだ場合、その後のイベントでまとめて実績が獲得されます。
blocks.translation: *Please note that the demo does not support achievements. If you carry your save data over to the full version, you will earn the achievements together during subsequent events.

blocks.source: なお、DLsiteで引き続き販売されていますので、Steamにこだわりがなければ普通にこちらで購入できます。
blocks.translation: It is still available for purchase on DLsite, so if you are not particular about Steam, you can simply purchase it there instead.

blocks.source: ※実績機能などSteam専用機能を除けば内容の違いは基本的にありません。既に先日のアップデートにより、Steamに公開予定のバージョン（ver1.07）と同様の内容になっています。
blocks.translation: *Other than Steam-exclusive features such as achievements, there are essentially no differences in content. Following the recent update, it already has the same content as the version scheduled for release on Steam (ver1.07).
